british-wildlife.title: British Wildlife
british-wildlife.blurb: Foxes, badgers, otters, deer and hares - the mammals of these islands, drawn as studies rather than as cartoons.

british-birds.title: British Birds
british-birds.blurb: Robins, wrens, kingfishers, owls and waders, taken from the British list and drawn one species at a time.

dogs.title: Dogs
dogs.blurb: Breed studies, from working terriers to gundogs and hounds. Generic breed names only - no named dogs, no mascots.

garden-flowers.title: Garden Flowers
garden-flowers.blurb: Roses, peonies, dahlias, tulips and the rest of the border, drawn as single specimens and small arrangements.

wildflowers.title: Wildflowers
wildflowers.blurb: Meadow and hedgerow flowers - poppies, cow parsley, foxgloves, harebells - named by common name.

trees.title: Trees & Shrubs
trees.blurb: Whole trees and shrubs by species, from English oak to monkey puzzle.

british-coast.title: British Coast
british-coast.blurb: Bays, coves, harbours and headlands of the British coastline, named place by named place.

mountains-hills.title: Mountains & Hills
mountains-hills.blurb: Munros, Welsh peaks, Lakeland fells and the ridges in between.

national-parks.title: National Parks
national-parks.blurb: The fifteen national parks of Great Britain, drawn as landscapes rather than maps.

lakes-rivers.title: Lochs, Lakes & Rivers
lakes-rivers.blurb: Still water and running water, from Highland lochs to chalk streams.

the-moon.title: The Moon
the-moon.blurb: Phases, supermoons and the named full moons of the year. The strongest single subject in this whole range.

constellations.title: Constellations
constellations.blurb: The twenty-four shapes a buyer can actually name, drawn as star maps.

styles.title: Charcoal Drawings
styles.blurb: Soft black charcoal on paper - smudged, worked, unmistakably hand made.

styles.title: Pencil Sketches
styles.blurb: Graphite line and hatching, left as a drawing rather than finished flat.

styles.title: Ink Wash
styles.blurb: Diluted black ink in washes - the monochrome end of painting.

styles.title: Linocut Prints
styles.blurb: Cut-block printing: bold shapes, visible carve marks, limited colour.

styles.title: Screen Prints
styles.blurb: Flat printed colour in layers, in the poster tradition.

styles.title: Watercolours
styles.blurb: Wet-on-wet washes, soft bleeds and pigment pooling at the edges.

styles.title: Gouache
styles.blurb: Opaque matte paint - flat, chalky and saturated.

styles.title: Pastel
styles.blurb: Dry pigment, grainy and soft-edged on toothed paper.

styles.title: Monotype
styles.blurb: One-off press prints: inky, textured, never quite repeatable.

styles.title: Cyanotype
styles.blurb: The Prussian-blue photographic process - white silhouettes on deep blue.

styles.title: Collage
styles.blurb: Torn and cut paper, assembled in layers.

styles.title: Riso Prints
styles.blurb: Duplicator printing - grainy, slightly misregistered, bright flat inks.

styles.title: Impasto
styles.blurb: Thick raised paint, built up so the surface holds the light.

styles.title: Palette Knife
styles.blurb: Paint laid in flat blades rather than brushed.

colours.title: Black & White
colours.blurb: One colour and its tones. The quietest option and the easiest to hang.

colours.title: Neutral & Beige
colours.blurb: Cream, bone, oatmeal and stone, with at most one small warm accent.

colours.title: Two Tone
colours.blurb: Two colours doing all the work - graphic and calm at once.

colours.title: Bold Colour
colours.blurb: Opposed colours at full strength, for a wall that needs an anchor.

colours.title: Colourful
colours.blurb: The full range, used across the whole picture.
